issues.surface: Order page › event header (compact TruckListCard), live event
issues.detail: The range wraps to 2 lines beside '● Live' in the 112 px date/time column, with leading-none (cramped). This happens in BOTH countries: GB '11:30 – / 22:45' (82 px of text in ~69 px of room), US '11:30 AM – / 10:45 PM' (126 px). Card height is the same in both (59 px), so US adds no growth here.
issues.measured: range natural width GB 82 px / US 126 px vs ~69 px available next to Live (35 px); 2 lines both; card 59 px both
issues.frequency: every order page for a live (open) event, GB and US
issues.fix: put '● Live' on the date line (or its own line), or widen the column to ~140 px; keep the range on one line (nowrap)

issues.surface: Order page › event header (compact TruckListCard), not-yet-live event
issues.detail: Every realistic US range is wider than the fixed 112 px column, so it wraps; GB fits on one line. '5:00 PM – 9:00 PM' breaks as '5:00 PM – 9:00 / PM' (an orphaned 'PM'); '8:00 PM – 12:30 AM' (midnight-spanning) and '11:30 AM – 10:45 PM' also wrap. The column does not widen at 768.
issues.measured: range natural width: GB 82–87 px (1 line) vs US 115 / 122 / 126 px (2 lines) in a 112 px column; card 51 → 59 px at 360/390, 54 → 60 px at 768
issues.frequency: every US order page for a pre-order (not yet open) event: practically every US pre-order
issues.fix: widen the compact date/time column to ~130 px, or drop ':00' (5 PM – 9 PM), or never break inside a time (non-breaking space before AM/PM, break only after the dash)

issues.surface: Order page › event chooser (full TruckListCard, no event selected)
issues.detail: From 640 px (sm:) the date/time column is 140 px. A live US event's range plus '● Live' needs 169 px, so the range wraps to 2 lines; GB needs 125 px and fits. Non-live US rows (126 px) still fit. On phones (360/390) the card uses a row layout and everything fits.
issues.measured: 126 + 8 gap + 35 Live = 169 px in 140 px; range 97 px wide × 2 lines; card 70 → 76 px (+6)
issues.frequency: US chooser on tablet/desktop width whenever one event is live
issues.fix: put Live on the date line, or widen the sm: column to ~175 px

issues.surface: Order page › sticky basket footer (fixed bottom)
issues.detail: The fixed footer gains the 'Menu prices don't include sales tax' line and, when expanded, four rows (Subtotal, Sales tax 8.875%, Online service fee, Tip 20%). Unlike the checkout sheet's summary, which is capped at 40vh, the footer's expanded breakdown has no height cap. With 6 lines it covers 85% of a 360×800 screen, leaving ~117 px of menu.
issues.frequency: every US basket (collapsed); expanded whenever the customer opens the summary
issues.fix: cap the expanded breakdown (max-h + inner scroll, as the sheet does), or fold tax/fee/tip into one 'Taxes, fees & tip' row that expands

issues.surface: Order page › checkout sheet (tip block + totals box before Place order)
issues.detail: The 90vh sheet gains the tip block (5 buttons, 52 px tall), the pay-at-truck note line and the totals box (4 rows + Total). Its basket summary is also expanded by default, so 'Place order' moves much further down. Every row stays on one line. The tip buttons fit but are tight at 360: '$203.95' is 49 px in 46–48 px of content in the selected (2 px border) 58 px button, with no clipping.
issues.fix: start the sheet's basket summary collapsed when a totals box is shown (the totals already restate the amount), or pin Total + Place order in a sticky sheet footer

issues.detail: '12:45 PM · Pier 13 Waterfront Market' (US) wraps to 2 lines and butts directly against the label ('Pickup12:45 PM'), because the justify-between row has no gap. The wrapped value is left-aligned while every other value is right-aligned. GB '12:45 · Pier 13 Waterfront Market' (218 px) fits on one line. At 390 and 768 the row fits.
issues.measured: value 236 px × 2 lines; label–value gap 0 px; row 20 → 40 px; GB 1 line
issues.frequency: US orders at venues with names over ~22 characters, on 360 px phones
issues.fix: add a gap and right-align (text-right) the value, or put the venue on its own line under the time

observations.note: TruckListCard is rendered without a `time` prop, so it falls back to DISCOVERY_TIME_SETTINGS (GB). A US truck's events read 'Wed 30 Sep 11:30 – 22:45' rather than 'Wed, Sep 30 11:30 AM – 10:45 PM'. The /api/embed/events payload carries no time settings either. The words are en-US; only the times and dates are GB.

Amounts print with no thousands separator by design (lib/money-format.ts: grouping off by default): '$1345.09', '£1019.75'. The brief's '1,234.56' would add 1 character; everything measured here has ≥ that headroom except the 360 tip buttons.
At 360 px 'Choose time' (97 px) overruns the ▾ by 5 px in both countries. These are words, not a US format.
At 360 px 'Vegan cheese instead of mozzarella': GB breaks the price as '+ / £15.00' across two lines; US wraps the name instead. Not caused by US formats.

For an event ending after midnight (e.g. 20:00–00:30) on today's date, `nowMins > endH*60+endM` compares with 30 minutes, so the page would mark it 'Ordering has closed' all day before it opens (GB and US alike). The midnight fixture was dated 7 Oct to avoid this state. Not verified at runtime.
No card-fee line appears: the Phase 3 resolver always returns surcharge null, so card_surcharge_minor is 0. ChargeRows would draw it as one more one-line row (label 'Card fee').

notChecked.why: There is no row of slot buttons: the picker is a native <select>, and its open list is drawn by iOS/Android, not the page. Only the closed select (selected value) and the option strings ('12:00 PM' … '10:45 PM') were checked.

Painted in Playwright WebKit with the compiled app CSS and the Geist fonts; device font rendering may shift widths by a few px

method: The real pages were server-rendered from fixtures with the render kit's state patches, the method of scripts/screenshots/order-us.cjs and phase3-screens-shots.cjs. No database or network: the kit stubs Supabase, and the custom-domain page reads an in-memory trucks row. Each page was then painted in Playwright WebKit with the compiled .next CSS and fonts from a 127.0.0.1 throwaway server, and measured in the browser at 360×800, 390×844 and 768×1024 (getBoundingClientRect, scrollWidth/clientWidth, line count = height/line-height, canvas text widths). Pages: app/trucks/[slug]/order/page.tsx in states menu / basket-expanded / event chooser / checkout sheet (slot 12:45 chosen, and ASAP) / confirmation (auto-accepted and pending); app/order/[id]/manage/page.tsx; app/trucks/[slug]/TruckClient.tsx (useVillageData answered from fixtures); app/domain/page.tsx, whose body is app/embed/[slug]/EmbedSchedule.tsx. Fixtures: Pizza Kitchen (test-truck / test-kitchen); GB = GBP, en-GB, Europe/London, 24h, no checkout rules (UK: VAT included, tips off, service fee not allowed by the seed); US = USD, en-US, America/New_York, 12h, sales tax 8.875% exclusive, tips on with 20% chosen, online service fee 3% + 30¢ (seed caps raised to 4% + 50¢ as phase3-screens-shots does), card payments on. The moment is Wed 30 Sep 2026 11:50 local (10:50Z / 15:50Z). Events: 11:30–22:45 (live), 17:00–21:00, 20:00–00:30. The basket is 6 lines / 107 items with modifiers (one list of 5) and special instructions: food 1019.75, GB total £1019.75, US total $1345.09; order number #1234 (a per-event integer counter). The public page and embed were also rendered as a labelled PROJECTION, with US time settings passed to TruckListCard by a bundle-time patch (never on disk). Scripts: scripts/us-layout-audit/A-customer/{fixtures,render,shoot,sheets}.cjs.
